title: Stabilization of swine faecal samples influences taxonomic and functional results in microbiome analyses
author: Monger, Saucier, et al.
materials: Extraction was performed using the QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Kit (QIAGEN, Toronto, Canada) using 250 µL of stabilized faeces or 250 mg of unstabilized faeces. The extracted DNA was eluted with 75 µL of buffer, quantified with the DNA quantification kit PicoGreen (Invitrogen, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA), and preserved at –20°C. DNA integrity was verified using an automated electrophoresis apparatus (Agilent TapeStation System, Agilent Technologies Canada Inc, Mississauga, Canada) with the Genomic DNA ScreenTape Analysis kit (Agilent Technologies Canada Inc).

steps.title: Collect faecal samples
steps.instruction: Aseptically collect faeces from each pig and place each sample into a PERFORMAbiome • GUT | PB‑200 tube following the manufacturer’s instructions; keep samples on ice during transport and freeze at –80 °C upon arrival in the laboratory.

steps.title: Apply stabilization/freeze‑thaw treatments
steps.instruction: Subject each collected sample to one of four experimental conditions:

substeps.instruction: S‑F‑T: stabilize on‑farm (add stabilizer in the tube), then freeze at –80 °C, then thaw (room temperature) before DNA extraction.
F‑T‑S: freeze at –80 °C, thaw at 4 °C for 7 h, then add stabilizer (PERFORMAbiome Gut) and keep at 4 °C until extraction.
F‑T‑S‑F‑T: perform the F‑T‑S steps, then after stabilization perform an additional freeze at –80 °C followed by a second thaw (room temperature) before extraction.
F‑T: freeze at –80 °C and thaw (room temperature) without any stabilization.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Kit (QIAGEN, Toronto, Canada) with either 250 µL of stabilized faeces or 250 mg of unstabilized faeces, following the kit protocol; elute the DNA in 75 µL of the kit’s elution buffer.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with the PicoGreen dsDNA quantification kit (Invitrogen, Waltham, MA, USA) and store the extracted DNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assess DNA integrity
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of each DNA sample on an Agilent TapeStation System using the Genomic DNA ScreenTape Analysis kit (Agilent Technologies Canada Inc.) to verify fragment size distribution.

steps.title: Prepare libraries and sequence
steps.instruction: Send the DNA samples to the Genome Quebec Centre of Expertise and Services (Montréal, Canada) for library preparation and sequencing on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform.

steps.title: Remove optical duplicates
steps.instruction: Process the raw Illumina reads with the clumpify tool from BBTools version 38.92 to eliminate optical duplicate reads.

steps.title: Filter low‑quality reads
steps.instruction: Run Trimmomatic version 0.39 on the deduplicated reads to trim adapters and discard low‑quality sequences.

steps.title: Remove host DNA
steps.instruction: Map the filtered reads to the Sus scrofa reference genome Sscrofa11.1 (RefSeq GCF_000003025.6) using Bowtie version 2.4.4 and SAMtools version 1.13; discard any reads that align to the pig genome.

steps.title: Metagenomic assembly and annotation
steps.instruction: Run the SqueezeMeta pipeline version 1.4.0 with default parameters and the co‑assembly option on the host‑removed reads.

steps.title: Integrate results in R
steps.instruction: Load the SqueezeMeta output into R using the SQMtools package to facilitate downstream taxonomic and functional analyses.

steps.title: Convert to relative abundances
steps.instruction: Transform raw taxonomic and functional count tables to relative abundances for comparison between samples.

steps.title: Alpha‑diversity analysis
steps.instruction: Calculate alpha diversity metrics with the Vegan R package; assess statistical significance using Prism version 9.2.0 with a Kruskal‑Wallis test followed by Dunn’s correction.

steps.title: Beta‑diversity analysis
steps.instruction: Compute beta diversity using the Phyloseq and Microbial R packages; visualise ordination (e.g., PCoA) and test differences as needed.

steps.title: Functional marker identification
steps.instruction: Identify differentially abundant functional markers with the ldamarker function of the Microbial package.

steps.title: Data deposition
steps.instruction: Deposit the whole‑genome shotgun sequencing data set in NCBI’s Sequence Read Archive under accession ID PRJNA801645.
